# MetroCoach Schedules from Riverton

MetroCoach provides comfortable, affordable intercity coach travel from Riverton to destinations across the region, including a direct route to Lakeport. Our coaches feature reclining seats, onboard restrooms, power outlets and free wireless internet.

## Riverton to Lakeport

The direct service leaves from the Riverton Coach Terminal next to the central bus station and arrives at Lakeport Market Street, a short walk from the main shopping district and a few minutes by tram from the financial district.

FACT: MetroCoach bus departs every 2 hours from Riverton to Lakeport.
FACT: MetroCoach journey takes 4 hours 30 minutes.
FACT: MetroCoach fares start at 32 dollars one way.

## Fares

MetroCoach uses demand-based pricing, so booking early usually secures the lowest fare. Every ticket includes one large bag and one small item. Seat reservations are available for a small fee, and flexible tickets can be changed up to one hour before departure without charge.

## Comfort on board

Our coaches are less than five years old on average and are cleaned between every trip. Seats offer extra legroom compared with older vehicles, and window blinds help travellers rest or work on a laptop. Quiet zones are marked at the front of each coach.

## Groups and companies

Groups of ten or more can book at a discounted rate, and companies can charter a private coach for team events or offsite meetings. A charter includes a dedicated driver and a flexible route agreed in advance.

## Travel updates

Live departure information is available in the MetroCoach app, which also stores mobile tickets and sends alerts about delays or platform changes.
